question.question: Scientific decision for Rheum palmatum — root extract containing emodin in an EU food supplement
question.indication: root extract containing emodin in an EU food supplement

records.notes: EU Annex III Part A prohibits emodin and all preparations in which emodin is present; the proposed rhubarb extract is declared to contain emodin.
